{"answer_markdown": "The Trade Lines come from the engine's rebalance-to-target logic, not from a judgement about individual instruments.

- **Starting point:** Portfolio Drift is 25.01 pp. Cash is 40.01% against a 15.0% target, and bonds are 40.01% against a 65.0% target. Equity is already close to its 20.0% target, so it needs little change.
- **Main trades:** The largest Trade Lines move money out of cash and into bonds. SGOV is sold (24.5% of the Portfolio), and AGG (14.68%) and SHY are bought.
- **Research tilt:** The remaining small lines in equity and sector ETFs (SPY, XLP, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLV, XLY) reflect the engine-bounded Research Tilt from approved Insights. The tilts are within the 2.0 pp bound and none are clipped. No Report passages are on this screen, so I can't cite research for any individual sector view.
- **Result:** After the trades, bonds would be 63.52%, cash 15.51% and equity 20.97%, with every asset class back inside tolerance and the post-trade Suitability rules all passing.
- **Approval:** Turnover is 25.85% of the Portfolio. Together with the two large single Trade Lines, that makes this a high-impact Recommendation, so it needs Advisor and Committee steps.", "claims": [{"asset": null, "citations": [{"figure": "portfolio_drift_pp", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "drift.cash.actual_pct", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "drift.cash.target_pct", "kind": "engine"}], "text": "Portfolio Drift is 25.01 percentage points, with cash at 40.01% against a 15.0% target."}, {"asset": null, "citations": [{"figure": "drift.bond.actual_pct", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "drift.bond.target_pct", "kind": "engine"}], "text": "Bonds are at 40.01% against a 65.0% target before trading."}, {"asset": null, "citations": [{"figure": "trade_line.SGOV.pct_of_portfolio", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "trade_line.AGG.pct_of_portfolio", "kind": "engine"}], "text": "The SGOV sell is 24.5% of the Portfolio and the AGG buy is 14.68%."}, {"asset": null, "citations": [{"figure": "post_trade_drift.bond.actual_pct", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "post_trade_drift.cash.actual_pct", "kind": "engine"}, {"figure": "post_trade_drift.equity.actual_pct", "kind": "engine"}], "text": "After the proposed trades, bonds would be 63.52%, cash 15.51% and equity 20.97%."}, {"asset": null, "citations": [{"figure": "turnover_pct", "kind": "engine"}], "text": "The rebalance carries turnover of 25.85% of the Portfolio."}], "follow_up_questions": ["Why is the Recommendation high-impact?", "How do the research tilts change the Trade Lines?", "Do the post-trade Suitability rules all pass?"], "in_scope": true}
